choreography.source: Shipped 286 is a CombatSpecialMove instant sneak opener; the ILDB "Sneak Attacks" group names its move 19593 (Twist Throw) and "Failed Sneak v <style>" variants.
choreography.runtime: SneakOpenerRound presents an at-rest landing as one Close Combat exchange naming that move to the caster, a player target and observers (observer-style combat view: spawn, initialize, round, final, delete), with no fight, then restores each fighter's pose. Inside an interlock the queued opener already presents as that fight's round.
choreography.test: CombatStyleTests.AtRestSneakOpenerRoundNamesItsSneakAttackMoveOrTheFailedSneakControl and AfterTheExchangeObserversGetTheFightersServerYawAndPosition; the ability-parity-sneak-opener-rounds bootstrap. Stock PR1194 native rerun at 29f3898a: the client played the full-body Twist Throw move (19593) with the close-combat camera on the at-rest opener, "does 528 damage", no Close Combat request or combat round, and the target kept its own facing afterwards. The PR1191 probe first showed this round record (variant a) plays the named move while an at-rest animation block (variant b) does not. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1191#issuecomment-7166175374 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1194#issuecomment-7167661159
